propositions: rebar comment silently accepts flag-like tokens (e.g. --body-file, --body) as the comment body and exits 0, discarding the intended content and creating a durability failure
positional-body commands lacking real flag support store flag-looking arguments literally as body text instead of rejecting them with a non-zero exit and usage message
a surplus positional argument holding the intended value is dropped by argument slicing when a flag-like token is mistaken for the body, creating a double-loss failure mode
the -- escape hatch allows users to supply body text that legitimately begins with a dash without triggering rejection
the guard and its supporting tests must span all positional-body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) to close the footgun uniformly
